scanNote:
103-BET. Unit 14 — plyajdagi xavfsizlik qoidalari.

17a-mashqda 7 ta surat (A-G) va 7 ta ko'rsatma bor. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  A = put suncream on skin (bolaga krem surayotgan ona — kitobda berilgan)
  B = wear a hat (somon shlyapali ayol)
  C = wear sunglasses (quyosh ko'zoynagidagi ayol)
  D = swim after eating (stol atrofida ovqatlanayotgan qizlar)
  E = play in the sun between 11am & 3pm (quyoshda o'ynayotgan qizchalar)
  F = drop litter on the beach (toshloq plyajdagi axlat)
  G = swim near windsurfers (vindserfing taxtasi va yelkani)

17b sabablar ham to'g'ri:
  suncream → skin protection; litter → looks and smells horrible; 11-15 quyosh → sun is very dangerous then; hat → protects your head; swim after eating → dangerous with a full stomach; sunglasses → protect your eyes; windsurfers → danger of accidents.

⚠ MANTIQIY TEKShIRUV: har bir sabab O'Z ko'rsatmasiga tegishli ekanini alohida tasdiqladim. Eng oson chalkashadigan joy — 'protects your SKIN' (krem) va 'protects your HEAD' (shlyapa) va 'protect your EYES' (ko'zoynak): uchtasi ham 'protect' fe'li bilan boshlanadi, faqat TANA QISMI farq qiladi.

⚠ 'They protect your eyes' — KO'PLIK 'they', chunki 'sunglasses' har doim ko'plikda. Qolgan ikkitasida 'It protects'.

⚠ ALWAYS / NEVER / DON'T: kitob shu uch so'zdan foydalanishni so'raydi.
  Foydali → ALWAYS (suncream, hat, sunglasses)
  Zararli → NEVER yoki DON'T (litter, 11-15 quyosh, ovqatdan keyin suzish, vindserferlar yonida suzish)

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to the instructions, then expand them into full sentences. Use always, never or don't.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ko'rsatmalarga moslang, so'ngra ularni to'liq gaplarga aylantiring. always, never yoki don't dan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM (A-G):

  A  Yo'l-yo'l soyabon ostida ona qizining
     yelkasiga quyoshdan himoya kremi surmoqda
  B  Keng somon shlyapa va ko'zoynak kiygan ayol
  C  Quyoshda yotgan, quyosh ko'zoynagi taqqan
     ayol
  D  Soyada stol atrofida OVQATLANAYOTGAN ikki
     qiz
  E  Ochiq quyoshda o'ynayotgan ikki qizcha
     (chelak-belkurak bilan)
  F  Toshloq plyajda sochilib yotgan AXLAT
     (shisha, chiqindi)
  G  Vindserfing taxtasi va rangli yelkani


YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  put suncream on/skin
  drop litter on/beach
  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm
  wear/hat
  swim after eating
  wear sunglasses
  swim near windsurfers


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (rasm + to'liq gap):

  put suncream on/skin  →  A  (KITOBDA NAMUNA)
     ALWAYS PUT SUNCREAM ON YOUR SKIN.

  drop litter on/beach  →  F
     NEVER DROP LITTER ON THE BEACH.
     (yoki: DON'T DROP LITTER ON THE BEACH.)

  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm  →  E
     NEVER PLAY IN THE SUN BETWEEN 11AM AND 3PM.

  wear/hat  →  B
     ALWAYS WEAR A HAT.

  swim after eating  →  D
     NEVER SWIM AFTER EATING.

  wear sunglasses  →  C
     ALWAYS WEAR SUNGLASSES.

  swim near windsurfers  →  G
     NEVER SWIM NEAR WINDSURFERS.


DIQQAT — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Birinchi katakchaga 'A' harfi ALLAQAChON
  yozib qo'yilgan.


UCh IJOBIY, TO'RT SALBIY:

  ALWAYS (3 ta) — nima QILISh kerak:
     put suncream on your skin
     wear a hat
     wear sunglasses

  NEVER / DON'T (4 ta) — nima QILMASLIK kerak:
     drop litter on the beach
     play in the sun between 11am and 3pm
     swim after eating
     swim near windsurfers


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — ALWAYS MI, NEVER MI:

  Ko'rsatma FOYDALI bo'lsa   →  ALWAYS
  Ko'rsatma XAVFLI bo'lsa    →  NEVER / DON'T

  Masalan:
     krem surish — himoya qiladi  → ALWAYS
     axlat tashlash — zarar        → NEVER


KO'RSATMALARNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitobda qisqartma shakl berilgan
  (chiziqcha bilan). To'liq gapda ARTIKL va
  EGALIK olmoshi qo'shiladi:

     put suncream ON/SKIN
       →  put suncream ON YOUR SKIN

     wear/HAT
       →  wear A HAT

     drop litter ON/BEACH
       →  drop litter ON THE BEACH

     play IN/SUN
       →  play IN THE SUN

  DIQQAT: 'the sun', 'the beach' — 'THE' bilan
  (yagona narsalar).
  'a hat' — 'A' bilan (bir dona shlyapa).
  'your skin' — EGALIK olmoshi.


DIQQAT — 'SUNGLASSES' DOIM KO'PLIKDA:
  'sunglasses'  ✓
  'a sunglass'  ✗
  Bitta juftlik: 'a pair of sunglasses'

  Shu kabi: glasses, trousers, scissors,
  slippers, chopsticks.


DIQQAT — 'BETWEEN ... AND ...':
  'between 11am AND 3pm'  ✓
  'between 11am TO 3pm'   ✗

  'between' DOIM 'and' bilan keladi.
  ('from 11am TO 3pm' — bu boshqa qurilma,
   u ham to'g'ri.)


DIQQAT — 'AFTER + -ING':
  'swim AFTER EATING'  ✓
  'swim after to eat'  ✗

  Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ING oladi
  (100-betdagi 'before smoking' bilan bir xil).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  suncream        = quyoshdan himoya kremi
  skin            = teri
  litter          = axlat (ko'chadagi)
  to drop litter  = axlat tashlamoq
  sunglasses      = quyosh ko'zoynagi
  a windsurfer    = vindserfingchi
  to expand       = kengaytirmoq

pairs.right: A — Always put suncream on your skin.
pairs.rightUz: A rasmi — Doim teringizga quyoshdan himoya kremi suring.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA 'A' ALLAQACHON YOZILGAN (namuna).

A rasmida ona qizining yelkasiga krem
surmoqda.

IJOBIY ko'rsatma → ALWAYS.
'on/skin' → 'on YOUR skin' (egalik olmoshi
qo'shiladi).

pairs.right: F — Never drop litter on the beach.
pairs.rightUz: F rasmi — Plyajga hech qachon axlat tashlamang.
pairs.whyUz:
F rasmida toshloq plyajda shisha va chiqindi
sochilib yotibdi.

XAVFLI/zararli → NEVER (yoki DON'T).
'on/beach' → 'on THE beach'.

99-betdagi varaqada ham shu qoida bor edi:
'Do not drop rubbish in the street.'
('litter' — ko'chada sochilgan mayda axlat.)

pairs.right: E — Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm.
pairs.rightUz: E rasmi — Soat 11 dan 15 gacha quyoshda o'ynamang.
pairs.whyUz:
E rasmida ikki qizcha OCHIQ QUYOSHDA o'ynayapti
(chelak-belkurak bilan).

XAVFLI → NEVER.
'in/sun' → 'in THE sun'.

DIQQAT: 'between ... AND ...' —
'between 11am TO 3pm' XATO.

B rasmida ayol KENG SOMON ShLYAPA kiygan.

IJOBIY → ALWAYS.
'wear/hat' → 'wear A hat' (artikl 'a'
qo'shiladi).

Sababi: bosh quyoshdan himoyalanadi.

pairs.rightUz: D rasmi — Ovqatdan keyin hech qachon suzmang.
pairs.whyUz:
D rasmida ikki qiz soyada stol atrofida
OVQATLANAYAPTI.

XAVFLI → NEVER.

DIQQAT: 'after EATING' — predlogdan keyin
fe'l -ING oladi ('after to eat' XATO).

pairs.rightUz: C rasmi — Doim quyosh ko'zoynagi taqing.
pairs.whyUz:
C rasmida quyoshda yotgan ayol QUYOSH
KO'ZOYNAGI taqqan.

IJOBIY → ALWAYS.

DIQQAT: 'sunglasses' — DOIM KO'PLIKDA,
artikl OLMAYDI ('a sunglasses' XATO).
Bitta juftlik: 'a pair of sunglasses'.

pairs.rightUz: G rasmi — Vindserfingchilar yonida hech qachon suzmang.
pairs.whyUz:
G rasmida vindserfing taxtasi va rangli yelkan
ko'rinadi.

XAVFLI → NEVER.

Sababi: tez harakatlanayotgan taxta suzuvchiga
urilishi mumkin.
'a windsurfer' — ham sportchi, ham taxtaning
o'zi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the instructions to the reasons.
exercises.explanationUz:
SABABLAR RO'YXATI (7 ta):
  • The sun is very dangerous then.
  • It protects your skin from the hot sun.
  • It protects your head from the sun.
  • There is always a danger of accidents.
  • It looks and smells horrible.
  • It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
  • They protect your eyes from the sun.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  put suncream on/skin
     →  It protects your SKIN from the hot sun.
        (KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN — NAMUNA)

  drop litter on/beach
     →  It looks and smells horrible.

  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm
     →  The sun is very dangerous THEN.

  wear/hat
     →  It protects your HEAD from the sun.

  swim after eating
     →  It is dangerous to swim with a FULL
        STOMACH.

  wear sunglasses
     →  THEY protect your EYES from the sun.

  swim near windsurfers
     →  There is always a danger of ACCIDENTS.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  SKIN (teri)      →  suncream (krem teriga
                      suriladi)
  HEAD (bosh)      →  hat (shlyapa boshga
                      kiyiladi)
  EYES (ko'z)      →  sunglasses (ko'zoynak
                      ko'zga taqiladi)

  Uchta 'protect' gapi tananing UCh a'zosini
  nomlaydi — shuning uchun adashish mumkin
  emas.

  FULL STOMACH (to'la oshqozon)
                   →  swim after eating
  ACCIDENTS (baxtsiz hodisa)
                   →  windsurfers (to'qnashuv)
  LOOKS AND SMELLS HORRIBLE
                   →  litter (axlat)
  THEN (o'shanda)  →  between 11am & 3pm
                      (vaqt haqida)


DIQQAT — 'IT' va 'THEY' FARQI ENG MUHIM KALIT:

  'IT protects your skin ...'   →  suncream
                                   (BIRLIK)
  'IT protects your head ...'   →  a hat
                                   (BIRLIK)
  'THEY protect your eyes ...'  →  sunglasses
                                   (KO'PLIK!)

  Ya'ni 'THEY' shakli o'zi aytib turibdi:
  javob KO'PLIK ot bo'lishi kerak.
  Ro'yxatdagi yagona ko'plik — SUNGLASSES.

  Va fe'l ham farq qiladi:
     it protectS  (III shaxs birlik → -S)
     they protect (ko'plik → -S YO'Q)


DIQQAT — 'THEN' SO'ZI:
  'The sun is very dangerous THEN.'
  'then' = o'sha vaqtda

  Demak sabab VAQT haqidagi ko'rsatmaga
  tegishli: 'between 11am & 3pm'.

  Nega o'shanda xavfli? Chunki quyosh eng
  tik turadi va nurlari eng kuchli bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'A FULL STOMACH':
  'to swim with a FULL STOMACH'
  = to'la oshqozon bilan suzmoq

  100-betdagi 'with your mouth full' bilan
  bir xil qurilma: 'with + ot + sifat'.


DIQQAT — 'PROTECT ... FROM ...':
  'protect + [nima] + FROM + [nimadan]'
     It protects your skin FROM the sun.
     ('protect from' — predlog 'from')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to protect ... from ... = ...ni ...dan himoya
                            qilmoq
  a danger      = xavf
  dangerous     = xavfli
  an accident   = baxtsiz hodisa
  a stomach     = oshqozon (o'qilishi /stamak/)
  horrible      = dahshatli
  then          = o'shanda, o'sha vaqtda

pairs.right: It protects your skin from the hot sun.
pairs.rightUz: U teringizni issiq quyoshdan himoya qiladi.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN (namuna).

KALIT: 'your SKIN' — krem TERIGA suriladi.

'IT protectS' — BIRLIK ('suncream'
sanalmaydigan).
'protect ... FROM ...' — predlog 'from'.

pairs.rightUz: U dahshatli ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
pairs.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LOOKS AND SMELLS HORRIBLE' —
faqat AXLAT haqida aytish mumkin.

99-betdagi varaqada aynan shu gap bor edi:
'Do not drop rubbish in the street. IT LOOKS
AND SMELLS HORRIBLE.'

DIQQAT: 'look/smell + SIFAT' (horrible),
RAVISH emas.

pairs.left: play in the sun between 11am and 3pm
pairs.right: The sun is very dangerous then.
pairs.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THEN' (o'shanda) — bu so'z VAQTGA
ishora qiladi.
Ro'yxatda vaqt aytilgan yagona ko'rsatma:
'between 11am & 3pm'.

Nega o'shanda xavfli? Kun o'rtasida quyosh
eng tik turadi, nurlari eng kuchli.

pairs.right: It protects your head from the sun.
pairs.whyUz:
KALIT: 'your HEAD' — shlyapa BOSHGA kiyiladi.

'IT protectS' — BIRLIK ('a hat').

Uchta 'protect' gapi tananing uch a'zosini
nomlaydi (skin / head / eyes) — shuning uchun
adashish mumkin emas.

pairs.right: It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
pairs.whyUz:
KALIT: 'a FULL STOMACH' (to'la oshqozon) —
faqat OVQATDAN KEYIN suzish haqida.

'with + ot + SIFAT' qurilmasi —
100-betdagi 'with your mouth full' bilan
bir xil.

'stomach' o'qilishi /ˈstʌmək/ ('stamak').

pairs.right: They protect your eyes from the sun.
pairs.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT:
  1) 'your EYES' — ko'zoynak KO'ZGA taqiladi
  2) 'THEY protect' — KO'PLIK!

Ro'yxatdagi yagona KO'PLIK ot —
SUNGLASSES ('sunglasses' doim ko'plikda).

Fe'lga ham e'tibor bering:
  it protectS   (birlik → -S)
  they protect  (ko'plik → -S YO'Q)

pairs.right: There is always a danger of accidents.
pairs.rightUz: Har doim baxtsiz hodisa xavfi bor.
pairs.whyUz:
KALIT: 'a danger of ACCIDENTS' (to'qnashuv
xavfi) — tez harakatlanayotgan vindserfing
taxtasi suzuvchiga urilishi mumkin.

'a danger OF something' — predlog 'of'.
'There is ...' — mavjudlik qurilmasi.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write leaflets giving rules, regulations, advice, instructions, etc, we write one rule after the other on separate lines. We use the imperative and words like never, always, make sure, etc. We may also give the reason why we should do what the rule says.
exercises.instructionUz: Qoida, nizom, maslahat, ko'rsatma beruvchi varaqa yozganda, har bir qoidani alohida qatorda, birin-ketin yozamiz. Buyruq maylini va never, always, make sure kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz. Qoidaning sababini ham berishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOZISh QUTISI — VARAQA QOIDALARI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA (to'liq):
  'When we write LEAFLETS giving rules,
   regulations, advice, instructions, etc,
   we write ONE RULE AFTER THE OTHER on
   SEPARATE LINES. We use the IMPERATIVE and
   words like NEVER, ALWAYS, MAKE SURE, etc.
   We may also give the REASON why we should
   do what the rule says.'

  KITOBDAGI MISOL:
     'Never light fires in forests.
      Trees will burn.'


VARAQANING BESH XUSUSIYATI:

  1  HAR QOIDA ALOHIDA QATORDA
     (one rule after the other on separate
      lines)

  2  BUYRUQ MAYLI (imperative)
     — ega yo'q: 'Wear a hat.'

  3  KUCHAYTIRUVChI SO'ZLAR:
        NEVER      — hech qachon
        ALWAYS     — doim
        MAKE SURE  — ishonch hosil qiling
        DON'T      — ...mang

  4  SABAB BERILADI (ixtiyoriy)
     'Never light fires in forests.
      TREES WILL BURN.'

  5  Qisqa va aniq gaplar


BU QOIDA 99-BETDAGI VARAQADA IShLATILGAN:
  'HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT'
     • Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
       The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
     • Use less washing-up liquid.
       It pollutes the seas and rivers.
     ...

  Ko'ryapsizmi — har bandda QOIDA + SABAB,
  alohida qatorda.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE SURE':
  'MAKE SURE you wear a hat.'
  = shlyapa kiyishni unutmang

  100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham bor edi:
  'MAKE SURE the toes are pointing towards
   the door.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a leaflet     = varaqa, buklet
  a regulation  = nizom, qoida
  separate      = alohida
  a line        = qator
  the imperative = buyruq mayli

points.en: When we write leaflets giving rules, regulations, advice, instructions, etc, we write one rule after the other on separate lines.
points.uz: Qoida, nizom, maslahat, ko'rsatma beruvchi varaqa yozganda, har bir qoidani alohida qatorda, birin-ketin yozamiz.

points.en: We use the imperative and words like never, always, make sure, etc.
points.uz: Buyruq maylini va never, always, make sure kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz.

points.en: We may also give the reason why we should do what the rule says.
Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
points.uz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOL.
1-qator — QOIDA, 2-qator — SABAB.
99-betdagi varaqadan olingan.

exercises.instructionEn: Write a leaflet giving advice to people on what to do while they are on the beach during the summer (50-80 words). Use ideas from Ex. 17, as well as your own ideas.
exercises.instructionUz: Yozda plyajda bo'lganlarida nima qilish kerakligi haqida odamlarga maslahat beruvchi varaqa yozing (50-80 so'z). 17-mashqdagi fikrlardan va o'z fikrlaringizdan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh:

  ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN

  'Summer is here. It's holiday time. Pack your
   things and head for the nearest beach. But
   keep in mind the following useful tips.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Yoz keldi. Ta'til vaqti. Narsalaringizni
   yig'ing va eng yaqin plyajga yo'l oling.
   Lekin quyidagi foydali maslahatlarni yodda
   tuting.'


TO'LIQ NAMUNA VARAQA:

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN

  Summer is here. It's holiday time. Pack your
  things and head for the nearest beach. But
  keep in mind the following useful tips.

  • Always put suncream on your skin.
    It protects your skin from the hot sun.

  • Always wear a hat and sunglasses.
    They protect your head and eyes from the
    sun.

  • Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm.
    The sun is very dangerous then.

  • Never swim after eating.
    It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.

  • Never swim near windsurfers.
    There is always a danger of accidents.

  • Don't drop litter on the beach.
    It looks and smells horrible.

  Have a wonderful summer!
  ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Qoidalar qismi ≈ 75 so'z — talab qilingan
  50-80 oralig'ida.


QISQAROQ VARIANT (≈55 so'z, agar kirish qismi
ham hisobga olinsa):

  • Always put suncream on your skin.
    It protects you from the hot sun.
  • Always wear a hat and sunglasses.
  • Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm.
    The sun is very dangerous then.
  • Never swim after eating.
  • Don't drop litter on the beach.
    It looks and smells horrible.

  Have a wonderful summer!


TUZILIShI — UCh QISM:

  1  SARLAVHA
     'ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN'
     (Katta harflar bilan, e'tibor tortadi.)

  2  KIRISh (kitob bergan)
     Yoz keldi → plyajga boring →
     LEKIN maslahatlarni yodda tuting.

  3  QOIDALAR RO'YXATI
     Har biri ALOHIDA qatorda, buyruq maylida,
     always/never/don't bilan, sababi bilan.

  4  YAKUN (ixtiyoriy)
     'Have a wonderful summer!'


O'Z FIKRLARINGIZ UChUN QO'ShIMChA G'OYALAR:

  • Always drink a lot of water.
    The hot sun makes you thirsty.
  • Never swim alone.
    It is very dangerous.
  • Always swim between the flags.
    Lifeguards can see you there.
  • Don't leave your things on the beach.
    Someone may take them.
  • Make sure children are never alone near
    the sea.


DIQQAT — 'HEAD FOR':
  'HEAD FOR the nearest beach'
  = ... tomon yo'l olmoq
  'head' bu yerda FE'L ('bosh' emas).


DIQQAT — 'KEEP IN MIND':
  'KEEP IN MIND the following tips'
  = yodda tutmoq
  'mind' = ong, xotira


DIQQAT — 'THE FOLLOWING':
  'the FOLLOWING tips' = quyidagi maslahatlar
  Ro'yxatdan OLDIN ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — SO'Z SANASh:
  Talab: 50-80 so'z.
  Kitob bergan kirish qismi (24 so'z) odatda
  HISOBGA KIRMAYDI — siz faqat QOIDALAR
  qismini yozasiz.
  Har bir qoida + sabab ≈ 12 so'z, demak
  5-6 ta qoida yetarli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to pack        = (yukni) yig'moq
  to head for    = ... tomon yo'l olmoq
  the nearest    = eng yaqin
  to keep in mind = yodda tutmoq
  the following  = quyidagi
  useful         = foydali
  a tip          = maslahat

2 va 3-qoida birlashtirildi (so'z tejash uchun).

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL:


 1  'WHEN IN ROME, DO AS THE ROMANS DO.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Rimda bo'lganingda, rimliklar qanday
     qilsa, shunday qil.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Har elning o'z odati bor.'
    'Kirgan yurtingning shohi bo'lmasang ham,
     odatiga qara.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Chet elga borganingda, o'sha yerning
    ODATLARIGA moslash kerak — o'zingnikini
    zo'rlab olib borma.

    NEGA BU UNITDA:
    100-bet AYNAN shu haqda edi —
    Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaning har birida
    o'z odoblari bor:
       Angliyada — navbatga suqilma
       Xitoyda — odamlar oldida o'pma
       Yaponiyada — oyoq kiyimingni yech

    Bir mamlakatda odobli bo'lgan narsa
    boshqasida qo'pol bo'lishi mumkin.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'WHEN IN Rome' = 'when YOU ARE IN Rome'
       (ega va 'to be' tushirib qoldirilgan —
        100-betdagi 'When in China' bilan
        bir xil!)

       'DO AS the Romans DO'
       'as' = ...day, ...dek
       Oxirgi 'do' — takrorlanishni oldini
       oladi ('do as the Romans do things'
       o'rniga).

    Kelib chiqishi: IV asrda Avliyo Ambrose
    aytgan maslahatdan.


 2  'EXPERIENCE IS THE BEST TEACHER.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Tajriba — eng yaxshi o'qituvchi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Ko'rgan — bilganini aytar.'
    'Yuz marta eshitgandan bir marta ko'rgan
     afzal.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Kitobdan yoki birovdan eshitib emas,
    O'ZING boshdan kechirib o'rgangan narsa
    eng mustahkam yodda qoladi.

    NEGA BU UNITDA:
    Butun unit MASLAHAT haqida edi
    (should, must, can). Bu maqol esa
    maslahatning CHEGARASINI ko'rsatadi:
    ba'zi narsalarni faqat o'zing sinab
    ko'rib bilasan.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'EXPERIENCE' — artiklsiz, chunki
       SANALMAYDIGAN ot (umumiy ma'noda).
       'AN experience' bo'lsa — bitta aniq
       voqea ('It was a strange experience').

       'THE BEST' — eng ustun daraja,
       'the' SHART.


DIQQAT — MAQOLLAR TARJIMA QILINMAYDI:
  Maqolni so'zma-so'z o'girish ko'pincha
  ma'nosiz bo'ladi. Har tilda O'Z muqobili
  bor.

  'When in Rome...' ni o'zbekchaga
  'Rimda bo'lsang...' deb o'girish emas,
  'Kirgan yurtingning odatiga qara' deyish
  to'g'ri.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  wisdom       = donishmandlik
  wise         = dono
  Rome         = Rim (shahar)
  a Roman      = rimlik
  experience   = tajriba (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  an experience = boshdan kechirilgan voqea
  as           = ...day, ...dek

patterns.exampleEn: Always wear a hat. Never swim after eating. Don't drop litter on the beach.
patterns.exampleUz: Doim shlyapa kiying. Ovqatdan keyin suzmang. Plyajga axlat tashlamang.
patterns.explanationUz:
Varaqaning asosiy qolipi.
FOYDALI → ALWAYS
XAVFLI → NEVER / DON'T

patterns.exampleEn: It protects your skin from the hot sun. They protect your eyes from the sun.
patterns.exampleUz: U teringizni issiq quyoshdan himoya qiladi. Ular ko'zlaringizni quyoshdan himoya qiladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'protect ... FROM ...' — predlog 'from'.
BIRLIK → it protectS (-S bilan)
KO'PLIK → they protect (-S siz)

patterns.exampleEn: It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
patterns.explanationUz:
'It is + SIFAT + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi
(100-betdagi 'It is polite to take a gift'
bilan bir xil).

patterns.formula: THERE IS ALWAYS A DANGER OF + [OT].
patterns.exampleEn: There is always a danger of accidents.
patterns.exampleUz: Har doim baxtsiz hodisa xavfi bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'a danger OF something' — predlog 'of'.
'There is ...' — mavjudlik qurilmasi.

patterns.exampleEn: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
patterns.exampleUz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Har qoida ALOHIDA qatorda,
keyin uning SABABI.
99-betdagi varaqa aynan shunday tuzilgan.

patterns.exampleEn: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when in X' = 'when you are in X'.
100-betdagi 'When in China' bilan bir xil.
